thig16.1:1.1: samatto. || Mantāvatiyā nagare rañño Koñcassa aggamahesiyā | dhītā āsi Sumedhā pāsādikā sāsanakarehi. || ||
thig16.1:2.1: sīlavatī cittakathikā bahussutā buddhasāsane vinītā | mātāpitaro upagamma bhaṇati ubhayo nisāmetha. || ||
thig16.1:3.1: nibbānābhiratā ahaṃ asassataṃ bhavagataṃ yadi pi dibbaṃ | kim aṅga pana tucchā kāmā appassādā bahuvighātā. || ||
thig16.1:4.1: kāmā kaṭukā āsīvisūpamā yesu mucchitā bālā |. te dīgharattaṃ niraye samappitā haññante dukkhitā. || ||
thig16.1:5.1: socanti pāpakammā vinipāte pāpabuddhino | sadā kāyena vācāya ca manasā ca asaṃvutā bālā. || ||
thig16.1:6.1: bālā te duppaññā acetanā dukkhasamudayoruddhā | desente ajānantā na bujjhare ariyasaccāni. || ||
thig16.1:7.1: saccāni amma buddhavaradesitāni te bahutarā ajānantā | ye abhinandanti bhavagataṃ pihanti devesu upapattiṃ. || ||
thig16.1:8.1: devedu pi upapatti asassatā bhavagate aniccamhi | na ca santasanti bālā punappunaṃ jāyitabbassa. || ||
thig16.1:9.1: cattāro vinipātā dve ca gatiyo kathañci labbhanti | na ca vinipātagatānaṃ pabbajjā atthi nirayesu. || ||
thig16.1:10.1: anujānātha maṃ ubhayo pabbajituṃ dasabalassa pāvacane | appossukkā ghaṭissaṃ jātimaraṇappahānāya. || ||
thig16.1:11.1: kiṃ bhavagatena abhinanditena kāyakalinā asārena | bhavataṇhāya nirodhā anujānātha pabbajissāmi. || ||
thig16.1:12.1: buddhānaṃ uppādo vivajjito akkhaṇo khaṇo laddho | sīlāni brahmacariyaṃ yāvajīvaṃ na dūseyyaṃ. || ||
thig16.1:13.1: evaṃ bhaṇati Sumedhā mātāpitaro na tāva āhāraṃ | āhariya gahaṭṭhā maraṇavasaṃ gatā 'va hessāmi. || ||
thig16.1:14.1: mātā dukkhitā rodati pitā ca assā sabbaso samabhisāto | ghaṭenti saññāpetuṃ pāsādatale chamā patitaṃ. || ||
thig16.1:15.1: uṭṭhehi puttaka kiṃ socitena dinnā si Vāraṇavatimhi | rājā Anikaratto abhirūpo tassa tvaṃ dinnā. || ||
thig16.1:16.1: aggamahesī bhavissasi Anikarattassa rājino bhariyā | sīlāni brahmacariyaṃ pabbajjā dukkarā puttaka. || ||
thig16.1:17.1: rajje āṇā dhanam issariyaṃ bhogā sukhā daharikā pi | bhuñjāhi kāmabhoge vāreyyaṃ hotu te putta. || ||
thig16.1:18.1: atha ne bhaṇati Sumedhā mā edisakāni bhavagataṃ asāraṃ | pabbajjā vā hohiti maraṇaṃ vā tena c' eva vāreyyaṃ. || ||
thig16.1:19.1: kim iva pūtikāyam asuciṃ savanagandhaṃ bhayānakaṃ | kuṇapaṃ abhisaṃviseyyaṃ gattaṃ sakipaggharitaṃ asucipuṇṇaṃ. || ||
thig16.1:20.1: kim iva t' āhaṃ jānantī vikūlakaṃ maṃsasoṇitapalittaṃ | kimikulālayaṃ sakuṇabhattaṃ kaḷevaraṃ kissa diyyatī ti, || ||
thig16.1:21.1: nibbuyhati susānaṃ aciraṃ kāyo apetaviññāṇo | chuṭṭho kaliṅgaraṃ viya jigucchamānehi ñātīhi. || ||
thig16.1:22.1: chaḍḍūna naṃ susāne parabhattaṃ nhāyanti jigucchantā | niyakā mātāpitaro kiṃ pana sādhāraṇā janatā. || ||
thig16.1:23.1: ajjhositā asāre kaḷevare aṭṭhinhārusaṃghāte | kheḷassumucchāssavaparipuṇṇe pūtikāyamhi. || ||
thig16.1:24.1: yo naṃ vinibbhujitvā abbhantaram assa bāhiraṃ kayirā | gandhassa asahamānā sakā pi mātā jiguccheyya. || ||
thig16.1:25.1: khandhadhātuāyatanaṃ saṅkhataṃ jātimūlakaṃ | dukkhaṃ yoniso aruciṃ bhaṇanti vāreyyaṃ kissa iccheyyaṃ. || ||
thig16.1:26.1: divase divase tī sattisatāni navanavā pateyyuṃ kāyamhi | vassasataṃ pi ca ghāto seyyo dukkhassa c' eva khayo. || ||
thig16.1:27.1: ajjhupagacche ghātaṃ yo viññū evaṃ satthuno vacanaṃ | dīgho tesaṃ saṃsāro punappunaṃ haññamānānaṃ. || ||
thig16.1:28.1: devesu manussesu ca tiracchānayoniyā asurakāye | petesu ca nirayesu ca aparimitā dīyante
thig16.1:29.1: ghātā. || || nirayyesu bahū vinipātagatassa kilissamānassa | devesu pi attaṇaṃ nibānasukhā paraṃ n' atthi. || ||
thig16.1:30.1: pattā te nibbānaṃ ye yuttā dasabalassa pāvacane | appossukkā ghaṭenti jātimaraṇappahānāya. || ||
thig16.1:31.1: ajj' eva tāta abhinikkhamissaṃ bhogehi kiṃ asārehi | nibbiṇṇā me kāmā vantasamā tālāvatthukatā. || ||
thig16.1:32.1: sā c' evaṃ bhaṇati pitaraṃ Anikaratto ca yassa dinnā | upayāsi pītaruṇāvuto vāreyyaṃ upaṭṭhite kāle. || ||
thig16.1:33.1: atha asitanicitamuduke kese khaggena chindiya | Sumedhā pāsādaṃ pidhatvā paṭhamajjhānaṃ samāpajji. || ||
thig16.1:34.1: sā ca tahiṃ samāpannā Anikaratto ca āgato nagaraṃ | pāsāde 'va Sumedhā aniccasaññā su bhāveti. || ||
thig16.1:35.1: sā ca manasikaroti Anikaratto ca āruhi turitaṃ | maṇikanakabhūsitaṅgo katañjali yācati Sumedhaṃ. || ||
thig16.1:36.1: rajje āṇā dhanam issariyaṃ bhogā sukhā daharikā pi | bhuñjāhi kāmabhoge kāmasukhā sudullabhā loke. || ||
thig16.1:37.1: nisaṭṭhaṃ te rajjaṃ bhoge bhuñjassu dehi dānāni | mā dummanā ahosi mātāpitaro te dukkhitā. || ||
thig16.1:38.1: tan taṃ bhaṇati Sumedhā kāmehi anatthikā vigatamohā | mā kāme abhinandi kāmesv ādīnavaṃ passa. || ||
thig16.1:39.1: cātuddīpo rājā Mandhātā āsi kāmabhoginaṃ aggo | atitto kālaṅkato na c' assa paripūritā icchā. || ||
thig16.1:40.1: satta ratanāni vasseyya vuṭṭhimā dasadisā samantena | na c' atthi titti kāmānaṃ atittā 'va maranti narā. || ||
thig16.1:41.1: asisūlūpamā kāmā kāmā sappasiropamā | ukkopamā anudahanti aṭṭhikaṅkālasannibhā. || ||
thig16.1:42.1: aniccā addhuvā kāmā bahudukkhā mahāvisā | ayoguḷo va santatto aghamūlā dukkhapphalā. || ||
thig16.1:43.1: rukkhapphalūpamā kāmā maṃsapesūpamā dukhā | supinopamā vañcaniyā kāmā yācitakūpamā. || ||
thig16.1:44.1: sattisūlūpamā kāmā rogo gaṇḍo aghaṃ nighaṃ | aṅgārakāsusadisā aghamūlaṃ bhayaṃ vadho. || ||
thig16.1:45.1: evaṃ bahudukkhā kāmā akkhātā antarāyikā | gacchatha na me bhavagate vissāso atthi attano. || ||
thig16.1:46.1: kiṃ mama paro karissati attano sīsamhi ḍayhamānamhi | anubandhe jarāmaraṇe tassa ghātāya ghaṭitabbaṃ. || ||
thig16.1:47.1: dvāraṃ apāpuṇitvāna 'yaṃ mātāpitaro Anikarattañ ca | disvāna chamaṃ nisinne rodante idam avoca. || || dīgho
thig16.1:48.1: bālānaṃ saṃsāro punappunaṃ ca rodataṃ | anamatagge pitu maraṇe bhātu vadhe attano ca vadhe. || ||
thig16.1:49.1: assu thaññaṃ rudhiraṃ saṃsāraṃ anamataggato saratha | sattānaṃ saṃsaritaṃ sarāhi aṭṭhīnañ ca sannicayaṃ. || ||
thig16.1:50.1: sara caturo 'dadhī upanīte assuthaññarudhiramhi | sara ekakappam aṭṭhīnaṃ sañcayaṃ Vipulena samaṃ. || ||
thig16.1:51.1: anamatagge saṃsarato mahiṃ Jambudīpam upanītaṃ | kolaṭṭhimattaguḷikā mātāpitusv eva na ppahonti. || || sara
thig16.1:52.1: tiṇakaṭṭhaṃ sākhāpalāsaṃ upanītaṃ anamataggato | pitusu caturaṅgulikā ghaṭikā pitupitusv eva na ppahonit. || || sara
thig16.1:53.1: kāṇakacchapaṃ pubbe samudde aparato ca yugacchiddaṃ | siraṃ tassa ca paṭimukkaṃ manussalābhamhi opammaṃ. || ||
thig16.1:54.1: sara rūpaṃ phenapiṇḍopamassa kāyakalino asārassa | khandhe passa anicce sarāhi niraye bahuvighāte. || ||
thig16.1:55.1: sara kaṭasiṃ vaḍḍhente punappunaṃ tāsu tāsu jātīsu | sara kumbhilabhayāni ca sarāhi cattāri saccāni. || ||
thig16.1:56.1: amatamhi vijjamāne kin tava pañcakaṭukena pītena | sabbā hi kāmaratiyo kaṭukatarā pañcakaṭukena. || ||
thig16.1:57.1: amatamhi vijjamāne kin tava kāmehi ye pariḷāhā | sabbā hi kāmaratiyo jalitā kuthitā kupitā santāpitā. || ||
thig16.1:58.1: asapattamhi samāne kin tava kāmehi ye bahusapattā | rājaggicoraudakappiyehi sādhāraṇā kāmā bahusapattā. || ||
thig16.1:59.1: mokkhamhi vijjamāne kin tava kāmehi yesu vaḍhabandho | kāmesu hi vadhabandho kāmakāmā dukkhāni anubhoni. || ||
thig16.1:60.1: ādīpitā tiṇukkā gaṇhantaṃ dahanti n' eva muñcantaṃ | ukkopamā hi kāmā dahanti ye te na muñcanti. || ||
thig16.1:61.1: mā appakassa hetu kāmasukhassa vipulaṃ jahi sukhaṃ | mā puthulomo va baḷisaṃ giḷitvā pacchā vihaññasi. || ||
thig16.1:62.1: kāmaṃ kāmesu damassu tāva sunakho va saṅkhalāboddho | khāhinti khu taṃ kāmā chātā sunakhaṃ va caṇḍālā. || ||
thig16.1:63.1: aparimitañ ca sukkhaṃ bahūni ca cittadomanassāni | anubhohisi kāmesu yutto paṭinissaja addhuve kāme. || ||
thig16.1:64.1: ajaramhi vijjamāne kin tava kāmehi ye sujarā | maraṇabyādhigahitā sabbā sabbattha jātiyo. || ||
thig16.1:65.1: idam ajaram idam amaraṃ idam ajarāmaraṇapadam asokaṃ | asapattam asambādhaṃ akhalitam abhayaṃ nirupatāpaṃ. || ||
thig16.1:66.1: adhigatam idaṃ bahūhi amataṃ ajjāpi ca labhanīyam idaṃ | yo yoniso payuñjati na ca sakkā aghaṭamānena. || ||
thig16.1:67.1: evaṃ bhaṇati Sumedhā saṅkhāragate ratiṃ alabhamānā | anunentī Anikarattaṃ kese 'va chamaṃ chupi Sumedhā. || ||
thig16.1:68.1: uṭṭhāya Anikaratto pañjaliko yāci tassā pitaraṃ so | vissajjethā Sumedhaṃ pabbajituṃ vimokkhasaccadassā. || ||
thig16.1:69.1: vissajjitvā mātāpitūhi pabbaji sokabhayabhītā | cha abhiññā sacchikatā aggaphalaṃ sikkhamānāya. || ||
thig16.1:70.1: acchariyam abbhutan taṃ nibbānaṃ āsi rājakaññāya | pubbenivāsacaritaṃ yathā byākari pacchime kāle. || ||
thig16.1:71.1: bhagavati Koṇāgamane saṃghārāmamhi navanivesamhi | sakhiyo tīṇi janiyo vihāradānaṃ adāsimhā. || ||
thig16.1:72.1: dasakkhattuṃ satakkhattuṃ dasasatakkhattuṃ satāni ca satakkhattuṃ | devesu upapajjimhā ko pana vādo manussesu. || ||
thig16.1:73.1: devesu mahiddhikā ahumhā manussakamhi ko pana vādo | sattaratanassa mahesī itthiratanaṃ ahaṃ āsiṃ. || ||
thig16.1:74.1: so hetu so pabhavo taṃ mūlaṃ satthu sāsane khanti | taṃ paṭhamasamodhānaṃ taṃ dhammaratāya nibbānaṃ. || ||
thig16.1:75.1: evaṃ kathenti ye saddahanti vacanaṃ anomapaññassa | nibbindanti bhavagate nibbinditvā virajjantī ti. || ||
